preface.p: Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment Act 2014
An Act to amend the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Act 2012, and for related purposes
Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Act 2012 3
Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment Act 2014
An Act to amend the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Act 2012, and for related purposes

content.p: This Act may be cited as the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment Act 2014.
This Act commences on the day this Act receives the Royal Assent.

Each Act that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: General amendments

hcontainer.name: amendedAct
hcontainer.heading: Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Act 2012

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Section 6 of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law (definition of defence vessel)

content.p: Repeal the definition, substitute:
defence vessel means:
a warship or other vessel that:
is operated for naval or military purposes by the Australian Defence Force or the armed forces of a foreign country; and
is under the command of a member of the Australian Defence Force or of a member of the armed forces of the foreign country; and
bears external marks of nationality; and
is manned by seafarers under armed forces discipline; or
a Government vessel that is used only on government non-commercial service as a naval auxiliary.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Section 6 of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law

content.p: Insert:
Government vessel has the same meaning as in the Navigation Act 2012.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: After paragraph 10(c) of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law

content.p: Insert:
to survey vessels and deal with matters relating to the survey of vessels by accredited surveyors;

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Subsection 11(3) of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law

content.p: Omit all the words after “that power or function”, substitute:
to an officer or employee (the sub-delegate) of:
if the delegate is an officer or employee of an agency of the Commonwealth—that agency; or
if the delegate is an officer or employee of an agency of a State—an agency of that State; or
if the delegate is an officer or employee of an agency of the Northern Territory—an agency of the Northern Territory.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Subsection 40(2) of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law

content.p: Repeal the subsection, substitute:
The National Regulator may vary a certificate of survey on the National Regulator’s initiative if the National Regulator is satisfied that:
the criteria prescribed by the regulations in relation to variation on the initiative of the National Regulator are met; and
it is desirable to do so, having regard to the objects of this Law.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Subsection 41(2) of the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law

content.p: Repeal the subsection, substitute:
The National Regulator must suspend a certificate of survey on the National Regulator’s initiative if the National Regulator is satisfied that the suspension is necessary for the purpose of:
protecting human life; or
securing the safe navigation of vessels; or
dealing with an emergency involving a serious threat to the environment.
The National Regulator may suspend a certificate of survey on the National Regulator’s initiative for a purpose prescribed by the regulations.
